name: M6 close-out remediation
goal: Fix the 2 critical + 2 important defects the tier-up end-review found in M6 /close-out: never integrate a rejected-rebase resolution (C1), preserve carried work across same-session row reuse via a preserved_work table + per-lifecycle recovery refs (C2, subsumes I1), auto-heal a recoverable integrated state (I2), plus cleanups.

tasks.name: C1 — never integrate a rejected-rebase resolution
tasks.description: Handler captures reconcileFinalization('continue') and proceeds only on {cleaned,integrated-local}; else returns it (preserve-and-defer); a continue-throw with a still-paused rebase returns the probe's own state. Defense-in-depth: finalizeCloseOut's ready branch requires cumulativeBinaryEffect equality (integration.ts:273/:1499-1501) before finalizeAttestedCandidate, else rebase-recovery-repair-required. Close-out's authority is evidence-light so this proof is the only review guarantee — it MUST have a falsifying test (a descendant-with-altered-content seed).

steps.description: RED-a (isAncestor disjunct): seed a ready_for_integration frozen-attached row (mirror seedFrozenReadyNoRebase(true) :198-222; HEAD===frozen, NOT a descendant of the advanced target). finalizeCloseOut → assert state==='rebase-recovery-repair-required', root main UNCHANGED, worktree preserved, row still ready_for_integration. NOTE today this THROWS at finalizeAttestedCandidate:927 (red via throw ≠ the asserted structured state), so it is red for the isAncestor reason.
steps.expected: FAIL (throws / not the asserted repair-required state).

steps.description: RED-b (the SECURITY falsifier — the equality clause): seed from seedFrozenReadyNoRebase(false), then in the worktree git reset --hard <root HEAD (=expectedTarget)>, write ALTERED content, git add+commit → HEAD is a DESCENDANT of expectedTarget whose cumulativeBinaryEffect DIFFERS from the frozen review. finalizeCloseOut → assert state==='rebase-recovery-repair-required', root main UNCHANGED, worktree preserved, row ready. NOTE today this INTEGRATES the altered content (main ADVANCES) — the real 'main advances' RED; deleting the cumulativeBinaryEffect comparison from the Step-4 gate turns this green→red (its only falsifier).
steps.expected: FAIL — altered content integrates, main advances.

steps.description: GREEN positive control: seedFrozenReadyNoRebase(false), reset --hard <expectedTarget>, cherry-pick <frozen> (non-conflicting → identical --binary --full-index patch → equal cumulativeBinaryEffect) → finalizeCloseOut assert state==='closed-out', root main advanced, worktree removed. Guards against an over-broad/inverted gate.

GREEN: finalizeCloseOut ready branch — before update-ref candidateRef/finalizeAttestedCandidate: frozen=freezeRef commit (dedupe the branch's existing rev-parse); target=targetRef; expectedTarget=target commit; reviewedEffect=cumulativeBinaryEffect(worktree, base_commit, frozen); if !isAncestor(primaryCheckoutPath, expectedTarget, headOid) || cumulativeBinaryEffect(worktree, expectedTarget, headOid)!==reviewedEffect return {state:'rebase-recovery-repair-required', detail:'Close-out: the rebase resolution changed the reviewed content; preserved for automated resolution (M7). Not an operator task.'}. Mirrors integration.ts:1499-1501; headOid in scope at :1372.

GREEN: index.ts closeOutWorktree — capture cont=reconcileFinalization('continue'); try/catch: on throw re-probe reconcileFinalization('status'); if probe.state is rebase-paused-conflict OR rebase-paused-clean return {state: probe.state, detail: `... pending automated resolution ... Not an operator task. (${msg})`} (use the PROBE's own state, obs 1); else rethrow. If cont.state ∉ {cleaned,integrated-local} return cont (preserve-and-defer).
GREEN: run suite + stage.
steps.expected: all pass incl. RED-a, RED-b, positive control.

tasks.name: C2 (+I1) — preserved_work table + per-lifecycle recovery refs survive row reuse
tasks.description: New additive preserved_work table (schema_migrations v4) + per-lifecycle content-addressed recovery refs (refs/ironclaude/recovery/<guid>-<oid>, create-only with tolerate-same-oid). Writers insert BEFORE/transactional-with the destructive step (I-4). drainCarriedObligations ALSO resolves via a direct preserved_work query (I-2). listPreservedWork = table UNION the existing abandoned-row query with dedupe (I-1). push-succeeded disposition clears without carry (obs 2). reuseTerminalAssignment + reaper BYTE-UNTOUCHED. Subsumes I1 (per-lifecycle refs).

steps.description: RED: (A) Case-A close-out carries pending-push, then ensureSessionWorktree again for the same session (reuseTerminalAssignment reuses the GUID) → listPreservedWork STILL returns the pending-push entry. (B) two dirty close-outs on the same GUID → two distinct refs/ironclaude/recovery/<guid>-<oid>, both resolve, listPreservedWork returns both. (C) an ABANDONED row with recovery_ref set (no table row) is STILL listed (I-1 UNION). (D) after (A), run a matching /push then drain → listPreservedWork empty for that guid (I-2 direct-query resolve). (E) a close-out whose disposition phase is 'push-succeeded' → cleared, no carry, no table insert (obs 2).
steps.expected: FAIL — wiped by reuse / clobbered / abandoned-row dropped / never resolved after reuse / push-succeeded carried.

steps.description: GREEN: db.ts migrateSchema after v3 — version-4 guard: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS preserved_work (id PK AUTOINCREMENT, workspace_guid NOT NULL, repository_identity NOT NULL, owner_session_id, kind CHECK IN ('pending-push','recovery'), payload NOT NULL, created_at, resolved_at) + index on repository_identity + INSERT OR IGNORE schema_migrations(4). Export insertPreservedWork (IDEMPOTENT on an unresolved (workspace_guid, kind, payload) — skip insert if such an unresolved row exists), listUnresolvedPreservedWork(db, repositoryIdentity, ownerSessionId) (resolved_at IS NULL), resolvePreservedWork(db, {workspaceGuid?, kind, predicate}) (sets resolved_at). Do NOT touch reuseTerminalAssignment. Update db.test.ts's three migration-version assertions [1,2,3]->[1,2,3,4] (sites :474,:552,:607) — v4 is a legit new migration those canaries must track.

GREEN: integration.ts writers. snapshotResidualIfDirty: mint refs/ironclaude/recovery/<guid>-<snapshot> CREATE-ONLY (update-ref <ref> <oid> '') with TOLERATE-SAME-OID (catch → rev-parse --verify <ref>^{commit} === snapshot ? proceed : rethrow — I-3); set assignments.recovery_ref to this ref AND insertPreservedWork(kind:'recovery', payload {ref, residualFiles}) BEFORE the rev-parse re-verify + reset --hard (I-4). closeOutRelease: if decodePushDisposition phase==='push-succeeded' → setDisposition(null), no carry/insert (obs 2); when carrying a pending-push, wrap transitionAssignment('integrated','cleaned') + insertPreservedWork(kind:'pending-push', payload JSON.stringify(pendingPush)) in ONE db.transaction (I-4). drainCarriedObligations: keep the matched-row resolve AND add a direct query of unresolved 'pending-push' preserved_work rows for the repositoryIdentity — parse payload, match remoteUrl/destinationRef, isAncestor(primary, payload.candidateCommit, pushedLocalOid) → resolvePreservedWork (I-2).

GREEN: index.ts listPreservedWork = listUnresolvedPreservedWork(db, repo.repositoryIdentity, identity.sessionId) mapped to {workspace_guid, kind, destinationRef?|ref?} from payload, UNION the EXISTING assignments cleaned/abandoned query WITH DEDUPE: emit all table rows first; then the assignments query, appending a pending-push leg only when no unresolved pending-push table row exists for that guid, and a recovery leg only when that exact ref value wasn't already emitted (I-1). Keep the existing C7 test shape.

tasks.name: I2 — auto-heal a recoverable integrated state in closeOutRelease
tasks.description: An integrated push-pending row with worktree HEAD at frozenCommit≠candidate is a reconcileFinalization-recoverable state (:1627-1633). closeOutRelease adds the dropped candidate/freeze consistency proofs (mirror :1614-1626) + self-heals (reset --hard integrated_commit when HEAD==frozenCommit && clean) so the verb completes instead of erroring. A no-disposition head-mismatch keeps the existing refusal.

steps.description: RED: seedIntegratedPushPending then git reset --hard <frozen> so worktree HEAD===frozenCommit≠candidate. finalizeCloseOut → assert closed-out (NOT a throw), worktree removed, row cleaned, pendingPush carried. RED: closeOutRelease throws at actualHead!==integrated_commit.
steps.expected: FAIL — closeOutRelease throws on the frozen-HEAD state.

steps.description: GREEN: closeOutRelease — after resolving current, before the clean/integration-proof block: candidate=candidateRef commit; if candidate!==integrated_commit throw 'Close-out candidate proof differs; preserving worktree'; in the existing disposition block require disposition.candidateCommit===integrated_commit && freezeRef===disposition.frozenCommit else throw 'Close-out push refs differ; preserving worktree'; self-heal: head0=worktreeHead; if head0!==integrated_commit && disposition && head0===disposition.frozenCommit && worktreeIsClean → reset --hard integrated_commit. No-disposition head-mismatch keeps the existing refusal.
GREEN: run suite + stage.
steps.expected: all pass incl. the frozen-HEAD heal.
